# Silent Hill PC port - no subtitles on voiced lines
#
# Drop this in gamedata/load/text_overrides/ (any filename), or paste it
# into gamedata/load/text_overrides.txt.
#
# Blanks only the lines the game has a recording for: those carry a
# ~J0(seconds) command that paces the scene to its clip, and the port keeps
# that command, so scenes run their original length with no text. Examine
# text, item and door prompts, notes, and the cutscene lines Harry has no
# recording for are not listed here and are unaffected.
#
# Generated by pc_port/localization/make_nosubs_override.py
# 295 voiced lines across 28 maps.
